Messages.Author: Chris
Messages.Body:
hi everybody,

i've read in the RTR May 1st thread, that a wake can get around a
sleeping mind. is this at superior SM or at inferior SM???

i understand that if your minions cannot untap to block, the can play
a wake, since the don't "untap" (sup SM)

now my question:

does a wake get around an inferior sleeping mind?
if this were so, then the card would be useless at inf, since a tapped
vamp has to untap, or wake to block anyway. (inf SM)

The Sleeping Mind
Only usable when the acting vampire's action is announced. [dom]
Choose a tapped vampire. The chosen vampire cannot attempt to block
this action. [DOM] Only usable when the acting vampire's action is
announced. Minions cannot untap during this action.

regards
chris
